chapter: Paris scene and a visit home, 1937-39
title: Big Boy Goudie, the New Orleans reedman
summary: Big Boy Goudie (Francis Goudie) played clarinet, tenor and trumpet and led the band the jammers played in; a born jazzman from New Orleans.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Oh, yes, sure I knew him well. Sure. Because I used to go down there and jam too. Big Boy, I think he had the band and Big Boy was in the band, and that's --
Big Boy played the clarinet, tenor saxaphone and trumpet. He was a born jazzman. You see, you got to watch those people --
He was from New Orleans. He was from New Orleans.
Frank -- Francis Goody Goudie. G-o-u-d-i-e, yeah Big Boy, very lovely person, very lovely person.
